agent.name: Oberhahn Visualizer
agent.description: Your personal AI-spend analyst. It runs a live dashboard against your Oberhahn ledger, answers questions about who ran what agent, on which project, with which model, and builds new charts the moment you ask for one.
agent.vibe: reads the ledger, finds the shape, draws it clean

secrets.name: OBERHAHN_API_KEY
secrets.description: Read API key (starts with oak_) from your Oberhahn dashboard under Settings → API Keys. Required to show real ledger data; without it the dashboard runs in demo mode on generated data.

secrets.name: OBERHAHN_URL
secrets.description: Base URL of your Oberhahn instance. Defaults to https://app.oberhahn.com — set this only if you run a self-hosted or staging instance.

scripts.build: cd workspace/projects/dashboard && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.start: cd workspace/projects/dashboard && HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=4321 node dist/server/entry.mjs
